image.alt: Understanding the Engine Options for the Volvo VNL 400

props.text: The new Volvo VNL 400 is a versatile truck engineered to support a wide range of business needs. Featuring advanced engine options like the Volvo D13, Volvo D11, and Cummins X15, the Volvo 400 truck ensures exceptional performance across various applications. Hudson County Motors complements this with tailored trucking solutions, helping businesses achieve optimal efficiency and reliability.

The Volvo D13 engine delivers the ideal mix of fuel efficiency and dependable performance for long-haul operations. With a displacement of 12.8 liters, it generates 375-500 horsepower and 1,450-1,850 lb-ft of torque, reducing fuel consumption while maintaining power.
The D13 uses turbo-compounding technology to enhance efficiency. This design increases payload capacity and reduces fuel costs.
Volvo D11: Ideal for Regional Routes

The Volvo D11 engine offers a compact yet capable solution for regional and local operations. With a power output of 325-425 horsepower and up to 1,550 lb-ft of torque, it is perfect for medium-duty applications such as urban deliveries and frequent-stop logistics.

With a compact size and reduced weight, the D11 enhances maneuverability and fuel efficiency, while its simplified design with fewer moving parts ensures lower maintenance costs over time. For businesses prioritizing cost-effective solutions, the D11 delivers consistent performance tailored to shorter routes.
Cummins X15: Power for Heavy-Duty Applications

Designed for long hauls and high-weight logistics, the Cummins X15 engine delivers consistent power and reliability, reducing downtime and boosting productivity in demanding operations. With a displacement of 15 liters, it provides up to 565 horsepower and 2,050 lb-ft of torque, ensuring the capability to manage heavy freight and steep inclines effortlessly.
Its extended maintenance intervals and rugged construction make the X15 a dependable choice for businesses requiring robust, high-performance engines.
